<!-- Please read this first — it saves us both time. -->

## Does this make Saturday's shop faster? (required)

Trug does exactly one thing: help a household get the weekly shop done faster.
It deliberately says **no** to anything that doesn't serve that — recipes and
meal planning, user accounts, multi-household support, and price tracking or
budgets are explicit non-goals, not missing features.

So before anything else: **make the case that this helps alice and bob get the
weekly shop done.** Be honest with yourself here. Ideas that don't clear this
bar get a kind, quick close with a pointer to why — not a long debate. If you're
unsure whether it fits, that's fine; say so, and we'll talk it through.
